bio:
Deadmau5, born Joel Zimmerman, is a Canadian EDM luminary who played a pivotal role in the genre's resurgence during the 2000s.

Zimmerman's musical journey began with piano lessons in his childhood, fueled by a passion for video games and computers. As a teenager, he experimented with music using old computer chips, co-producing a dance music program at a Niagara Falls radio station. His early ventures led him to compose for a stock music company.

In 2002, Zimmerman's peculiar encounter with a dead mouse in his computer earned him the nickname "dead mouse guy." Embracing the moniker, he adopted the shortened form, Deadmau5, as his chat room username. Under this alias, he released his debut album, "Get Scraped," in 2005 through ZOOLOOK records.

The glitchy and 8-bit-inspired sound of his second album, "Vexillology" (2006), showcased Zimmerman's affinity for 1990s electronica. In 2007, he founded his record label, mau5trap records, setting the stage for his ascent.

The breakthrough came in 2008 when Deadmau5 won a Juno Award for "All U Ever Want," a collaboration with Billy Newton-Davis. The following year, "Random Album Title" catapulted him into the mainstream, featuring hits like "Faxing Berlin" and "I Remember," which dominated Billboard's dance charts.

Subsequent albums, including "For Lack of a Better Name" (2009), the Grammy-nominated "4x4=12" (2010), and "Album Title Goes Here" (2012), solidified Deadmau5's position. The latter secured the top spot on the Billboard dance/electronic albums chart, earning him a second Grammy nomination.

Deadmau5's contributions extend beyond music, symbolized by his iconic Mau5head logo and the establishment of mau5trap records. With a career marked by innovation and accolades, Deadmau5 continues to shape the landscape of electronic dance music, showcasing his dance floor-friendly signature sound.
name: deadmau5
